notes.title: Hero must die. again - Inventory bug fix
notes.content:
[h2]Hero can't hold on to more items...[/h2]

The following bug has been fixed.

When the inventory is full and you swap your equipped weapon with weapons that are in a stack of 2 or more, the equipped item will be lost.

tags.bug: When the inventory is full and you swap your equipped weapon with weapons that are in a stack of 2 or more, the equipped item will be lost.
